items.label: TLS endpoints
items.purpose: Find public TLS certificate metadata on explicitly authorized hosts, addresses, and network ranges.
items.data_handling: Connects only to the normalized targets in the approved plan, performs a bounded TLS handshake, and stores public certificate metadata. It does not exploit services or collect private keys.

configuration.label: Authorized scope
configuration.description: A declared tenant scope that defines the scan denominator.

configuration.label: Network relay
configuration.description: Where connections originate. The relay must have the network role.

configuration.label: Hosts and addresses
configuration.description: Individual host:port or address:port targets.

configuration.label: CIDR ranges
configuration.description: IPv4 or IPv6 CIDRs crossed with the selected ports.

configuration.label: Explicit IP ranges
configuration.description: Bounded inclusive start-end address ranges crossed with the selected ports.

configuration.label: Ports
configuration.description: Individual ports or bounded ranges normalized before the scan is queued.

configuration.label: Excluded hosts and targets
configuration.description: Exact hostnames, addresses, or host:port destinations removed after normalization.

configuration.label: Excluded CIDR ranges
configuration.description: Address ranges removed after normalization; exclusions always win.

configuration.label: Excluded ports
configuration.description: Ports removed from every normalized target.

configuration.label: Allow approved RFC1918 targets
configuration.description: Permits private IPv4 targets already covered by the declared scope.

configuration.label: Allow loopback
configuration.description: Restricted local-testing override; never implied by private-range access.

items.label: SSH endpoints
items.purpose: Find public SSH host-key metadata on explicitly authorized machines and network ranges.
items.data_handling: Connects only to the normalized targets in the approved plan, reads the bounded SSH identification and host-key exchange, and stores public fingerprints. It never attempts a login.

items.label: Microsoft AD CS
items.purpose: Inventory AD CS authorities, templates, enrollment rights, and exposed enrollment endpoints through a domain-reachable relay.
items.data_handling: Performs bounded read-only LDAP and configured endpoint checks. Passwords are represented only by credential references; response bodies and private keys are never stored.

configuration.label: Directory URL
configuration.description: LDAPS or LDAP endpoint reachable from the selected relay.

configuration.label: Configuration naming context
configuration.description: The AD Configuration partition to inspect.

configuration.label: Bind identity
configuration.description: A least-privilege directory reader.

configuration.label: Password reference
configuration.description: Reference to the bind password; the value is never sent in this configuration.

configuration.label: Network relay
configuration.description: An enrolled network-role agent that can reach the directory.

configuration.label: Enrollment endpoints
configuration.description: Optional bounded checks for enrollment web services.

configuration.label: Allow approved private endpoints
configuration.description: Requires private-egress authorization and explicit CIDRs.

configuration.label: Approved private endpoint CIDRs
configuration.description: Private destinations allowed for this source; metadata, loopback, and link-local ranges remain blocked.

items.label: Cloud certificate services
items.purpose: Inventory certificate metadata from AWS Certificate Manager, Azure Key Vault, and Google Cloud Certificate Manager.
items.data_handling: Uses read-only provider calls and credential references. It stores public certificate metadata and provider provenance, never private keys or inline cloud credentials.

items.label: Cloud secret managers
items.purpose: Inventory every authorized secret resource's metadata without retrieving its value; optionally inspect content for certificates through a separate explicit choice.
items.data_handling: Metadata-only is the default. Optional content inspection retrieves only candidate values, keeps them in wipeable bytes, emits certificate metadata only, and never persists, logs, or renders the value.
